# Biztrait Tools & Bots Market Play

> The unified marketplace for automation APIs, AI workflow tools, and one-click Discord bots. Deploy trigger APIs, audience-growth engines, and managed Discord bots from one central hub.

Biztrait helps creators, marketers, streamers, and developers automate work across YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok, X, Discord, Slack, and more. Tools are organized into seven categories — Core Automation APIs, Social Triggers, Audience Engagement, Marketing & Creator Growth, Custom Discord Bot Marketplace, Streaming, and AI Workflows — each with subscription pricing and full REST/Webhook documentation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Biztrait Market Play and featured categories.
- [Tools Marketplace](/tools): Searchable directory of every automation tool and API.
- [API Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse and subscribe to production-ready automation APIs.
- [Categories](/categories): All seven automation and bot categories.
- [Integrations](/integrations): 180+ native platform connectors.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter, Professional, Business, and Enterprise plans.
- [Documentation](/docs): API reference, SDKs, and integration guides.
- [Blog](/blog): Automation playbooks, product updates, and engineering posts.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales, support, and partnership inquiries.
